components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#B8E85C; color:#0A0E0C; border:0; border-radius:8px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; font:600 14px Geist,Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s,transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#A3D944; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #B8E85C; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#161D19; color:#EDEFEA; border:1px solid #1E2521; border-radius:8px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; font:600 14px Geist,Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#1D2721; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #B8E85C; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:36px; box-sizing:border-box; background:#101512; color:#EDEFEA; border:1px solid #1E2521; border-radius:8px; padding:4px 12px; font:14px Geist,Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#8A9289; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #B8E85C; border-color:#B8E85C; }

components.name: Work Panel
components.css: .ds-card { background:#101512; color:#EDEFEA; border:1px solid #1E2521; border-radius:12px; padding:24px; font-family:Geist,Inter,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05); } .ds-card strong { display:block; font-size:18px; } .ds-card p { margin:6px 0 0; color:#8A9289; font-size:14px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 8px; background:#161D19; border:1px solid #1E2521; border-radius:9999px; color:#EDEFEA; font:600 11px 'JetBrains Mono',Menlo,monospace; } .ds-chip i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#B8E85C; }

narrative.overview: Payload Forge is a dark, compact operations workspace for configuring traffic and reading runtime signal. Green-black surfaces minimize ambient noise; lime carries decisive action, while mint, amber, coral, and gray state colors make outcomes legible. The interface is deliberately practical: structured panels, dense controls, monospaced machine-adjacent values, and restrained motion.
keyCharacteristics: Deep evergreen canvas with layered dark surfaces.
Signal Lime reserved for primary action and live emphasis.
Stable borders and tonal contrast establish structure before shadow.
Dense controls stay readable through a consistent spacing rhythm.

rules.name: Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Use Signal Lime for one decisive action or active readout in a region; never as general decoration.

rules.name: Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Use mono only when content is code, data, or a machine-adjacent value.

rules.name: Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tone and border first; reserve stronger shadow for overlays.

dos: Do reserve Signal Lime for decisive actions, selection, and active state.
Do name status in text as well as color.
Do use mono for payloads, methods, paths, IDs, and measured operational values.
Do preserve 1px borders around long-lived panels and controls.
donts: Don't use lime, mint, coral, or amber as interchangeable decoration.
Don't use monospace for ordinary prose.
Don't hide errors, warnings, or live state in color alone.
Don't add glass effects, glowing cards, or decorative gradients.
